verdicts.reason: A breaks the hero apart: the green circle sits alone, cropped, at the far left, and the can floats tiny at the far right, leaving dead space between them. The SOLSTICE wordmark has dropped below the headline, the CTA is shrunk to a small pill in a row with the badges so it no longer stands out, and the body copy is too small to read. B keeps the can on its circle at the left, puts the brand above the headline and gives the CTA real weight at the right end, so it reads left to right as a banner should. Its flaws: the circle is cropped into a squashed oval, the body copy is still tiny and wraps 'battles.' onto its own line, and the badges float in the middle, cut off from the copy.
